item.title: Figures discusses early childhood education at CLC
item.description: U.S. Rep. Shomari Figures, D-Mobile, stopped by the Christian Love Community Center in Troy to discuss early childhood education. Joining members of the early childhood learning center were Pike County Commissioners Robin Sullivan and Cynthia Pierson; Pike County Board of Education Member Earnest Green; Dr. Ben Smith; and other community leaders. item.title: Troy Men drop two straight
item.description: Troy men drop first back-to-back games since November, falling to James Madison and Appalachian State with season-low offense but still first in Sun Belt ahead of Georgia State trip.

item.title: Trojan women look for fourth consecutive conference win
item.description: Troy women chase fourth straight Sun Belt win Wednesday vs. Appalachian State after an 88-77 road victory at Coastal Carolina lifted them into a tie for second place.

item.title: Local Hoops Roundup: Lady Trojans survive to remain undefeated
item.description: No. 3 Charles Henderson girls survive 47-43 scare vs Greenville to stay 24-0, while the boys edge Greenville and area teams see mixed results in local hoops action.

item.title: Charles Henderson takes two indoor track state championships
item.description: Charles Henderson track earns two AHSAA 4A-5A indoor state titles as Peyton Ousley repeats in 60m dash and boys 4x200 relay team claims gold in Hoover.

item.title: Troy University Relations Coordinator hikes for A cause
item.description: Troy University alumna Savanah Weed is training for a 26.3-mile Trail Blaze Challenge hike on Alabama’s Pinhoti Trail to raise $2,500 for Make-A-Wish Alabama.

item.title: Ariton senior Wells Ganey signs with Wallace College
item.description: Ariton catcher Wells Ganey signs with Wallace College after an All-State junior year and now targets getting on base, stealing bags, a state title and a future at a four-year school.

item.title: Troy University gets final approval for new Doctor of Chiropractic Program
item.description: Troy University secures final approval to launch its Doctor of Chiropractic program at the Dothan campus, with the first cohort expected in Fall 2027.

item.title: Pike County High School hires new coaches Jimmy Godwin, Justin Cope
item.description: Pike County High adds coaches with local roots as Justin Cope returns as defensive coordinator/assistant head coach and Jimmy Godwin leads strength and conditioning.

item.title: Portion of Pike County Road 3346 to be closed Feb. 3
item.description: The Pike County Road Department has announced that a portion of Pike County Road 3346 will be temporarily closed on Feb. 3. County Road 3346 south of Tarentum at a point approximately 0.74 miles west of Alabama Highway 125, near the Coffee County line, will be closed for pipe replacement. The road will be closed from 8 a.m. until the close of the day. There will be no through traffic and no detour available.
